svg.text: Breadboard layout: board, pots, sync input
Board stays on the header; wires from header pins to the breadboard. Speaker plugs into H2 on the board.
Breadboard + female-to-male jumper wires (for the P1 header)
Optional sync: 1k, 10k, 20k resistors, 1N4148 diode, 5 V sync source with a 3.5 mm or cable lead
Speaker 4-8 ohm, about 1 W, with a PH2.0 plug (into H2 on the board)
Optional: 3 x 100 nF caps (wiper to GND) to reduce ADC noise
red: 3V3 (P1 pin 1) to the + rail, and pot pin 1 to the + rail
black: GND (P1 pin 3) to the - rail, and pot pin 3 to the - rail
yellow: pot wiper to its GPIO (P1 pins 7, 9, 11) teal: sync to GPIO17 (P1 pin 13) orange: sync divider
Speaker option (on the breadboard): H2 plug with leads -> columns 1 (+) and 2 (-); speaker legs go in the same columns.
Do not connect either speaker lead to GND. The amplifier output is bridge-tied, so both leads float.
Use a PH2.0 plug with leads (or cut a PH2.0 cable). Keep the leads short.
